Rainy Season Glow Starts Here ✨

Just because the weather is gloomy doesn’t mean your skin has to be.

The rainy season is the perfect time to focus on hydration, balance, and professional skin care. Regular facial treatments can help keep your skin feeling fresh, healthy, and radiant despite the humidity and daily stress.

Give your skin the care it deserves this season.

Which Facial Is Best for the Rainy Season? ☔

Not all skin concerns are the same. Here’s a quick guide to help you choose:

🌿 Oily or acne-prone skin
→ P3 Pore Tightening & Sebum Control

💧 Dry or dehydrated skin
→ P6 Collagen Extra Plus Rejuvenating

✨ Dull and tired-looking skin
→ P7 Oxygen Jet Skin Brightening

💎 Premium anti-aging care
→ P11 Korean Style Premium Anti-Aging & Anti-Wrinkle

Not sure which treatment is right for you? Our team is happy to help recommend the best option for your skin.

Feeling Tired? Your Skin Can Show It Too ☁️

Long commutes, grey skies, busy schedules, and less sunshine can leave you feeling drained and your skin often reflects it.

You may notice:
✨ Dull-looking skin
✨ Lack of radiance
✨ Tired appearance
✨ Uneven texture

Sometimes all your skin needs is a boost of hydration and revitalization.

Our P7 Oxygen Jet Skin Brightening treatment helps refresh tired skin and restore a healthy-looking glow.

📲 Book your skin refresh today

How to Keep Your Skin Fresh on Rainy Days 🌿

A few simple habits can help your skin stay healthy during the rainy season:

✔ Cleanse gently morning and night
✔ Keep your skin hydrated
✔ Wear sunscreen even on cloudy days
✔ Avoid touching your face unnecessarily
✔ Schedule regular facial care to keep pores clean

Small changes can make a big difference when it comes to maintaining clear, balanced skin.

3 Rainy Season Skincare Mistakes to Avoid ☔

Your skin needs different care during the rainy season. Here are some common mistakes:

❌ Over-cleansing to remove oil
❌ Skipping moisturizer because the weather feels humid
❌ Touching your face too often throughout the day

These habits can disrupt your skin barrier and lead to irritation, dehydration, or breakouts.

Instead, focus on gentle cleansing, proper hydration, and consistent skincare habits.

Your skin will thank you ✨

Rainy Days Can Still Leave Your Skin Dehydrated 💧

Many people think humid weather automatically means hydrated skin but that’s not always true.🤫

Your skin can be oily on the surface while still lacking moisture underneath. When this happens, skin may look dull, feel uncomfortable, and become more prone to irritation.😐

The secret isn’t removing all the oil, it’s maintaining the right balance of hydration.

✨ Treatments like our P6 Collagen Extra Plus Rejuvenating help support moisture retention and keep skin looking healthy and refreshed.

Why Am I Breaking Out More During the Rainy Season?😓

If your skin seems to break out more during this time of year, you’re not alone.💁‍♀️

Humidity can increase oil production, while sweat, dirt, and pollution can build up on the skin and clog pores more easily. The result? More congestion and unwanted breakouts.😵

Keeping your skin clean, balanced, and properly cared for is key during the rainy season.

✨ Our P3 Pore Tightening & Sebum Control treatment is designed to help manage excess oil and keep skin feeling fresh and clear.

Rainy Season, Different Skin Challenges ☔

The rainy season can be tough on your skin. Increased humidity, pollution, and constant weather changes may leave your skin feeling oily, congested, or more sensitive than usual.

You might notice:
✨ Excess oil throughout the day
✨ More clogged pores
✨ Unexpected breakouts
✨ Skin that feels unbalanced

The good news? A few adjustments to your skincare routine can help keep your skin healthy and comfortable all season long.

📲 Message us for personalized treatment recommendations

Your Skin Deserves Gentle Care🧖‍♀️

If your skin feels irritated, stressed, oily, or tired, it may be time to slow down and give it proper care.

Professional treatments can help support your skin without harsh irritation especially when your skin barrier feels overwhelmed.

Healthy skin starts with understanding and consistency 🌿

📲 Book your facial appointment with us ✨

Healthy Skin Takes Consistency💁‍♀️

Clearer skin doesn’t happen overnight  and that’s okay ✨

Real skin progress comes from consistency, proper care, and treatments suited to your skin condition.

We’re always grateful to see our customers feel more confident and comfortable in their skin journey 💛

hotelDescription:
In a timber-framed villa dating from 1942, this chic, upscale hotel is a 10-minute walk from the Phloen Chit Skytrain station, 3 km from shopping at MBK Center and 13 km from the Grand Palace.
 Featuring wood floors and floor-to-ceiling windows, the elegant rooms come with flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi and ceiling fans. Upgraded rooms include sitting areas, while suites offer 4-poster beds.
 Breakfast and parking are complimentary. There's a relaxed restaurant with teak floors and high ceilings. Other amenities include an outdoor pool, a library, a spa and a gym.

updatesFromCustomers.text:
**A peaceful oasis in the heart of Bangkok**
This is a truly special place. Tucked away at the quiet end of the street, it's within walking distance of the city centre and Bumrungrad International Hospital, yet feels wonderfully private and peaceful.
I stayed here for four nights while recovering from surgery, and it couldn't have been a better choice. The staff were exceptional—warm, attentive and genuinely caring without ever feeling overly formal. They made me feel completely at home.

My spacious room overlooked a lush garden with a small private patio where I spent my days reading, waking to birdsong and falling asleep to the sound of rain. The bathroom was beautiful, and every detail of the property reflects thoughtful design and genuine love.
I noticed some reviews complaining about the trees, birds, humidity or distance from the BTS. To me, that's part of the charm. This is Southeast Asia—lush, tropical and alive. If you're looking for a sterile chain hotel next to a train station, this probably isn't the place for you. I've stayed in many hotels across Bangkok over the past decade, and this has become my favourite. This was my second visit, and it exceeded all expectations. I left feeling fully recovered, rested and already looking forward to coming back.

Juvenile Trevally decided to join us on our Fundive ! 

Ever feel like you're being followed while diving? 👀🌊

That's just part of the magic of exploring Koh Tao's incredible dive sites! 💙

On today's dive we were surrounded by amazing marine life, including:
 🐟 Juvenile trevally ✨ Schooling ox-eyed scad ⚡ Barracudas 🌊 And so much more!

Every dive is different, and you never know what you'll encounter beneath the surface.

🤿 Join our daily fun dive trips and experience the underwater world of Koh Tao with us!

Scuba Diving in July on Koh Tao

July is one of the best times to experience scuba diving on Koh Tao. With warm tropical waters, calm sea conditions, and excellent underwater visibility, it's the perfect month to explore the island's vibrant coral reefs and abundant marine life.

Whether you're taking your first breaths underwater or adding to your diving experience, the conditions are ideal for divers of all levels.

Looking to learn together? PADI dive courses are available for the whole family, making it easy to create unforgettable memories beneath the surface. Children can join the adventure too, with the PADI Junior Open Water Diver course available from 10 years old. It's a fun, safe, and exciting way for families to discover the underwater world together.

From colourful reef fish and sea turtles to stunning coral gardens, July offers incredible diving experiences for everyone. If you've been thinking about learning to dive, there's no better place or time, than Koh Tao.

Contact us for details 📩

📧 info@assavadiveresort.com 📱 WhatsApp: +66 80 173 1136 🌐

Ready to explore some of the best dive sites around Koh Tao? 🌊🐠

ownerUpdates.text:
When Robots Begin to Give Massages, Where Does the Value of the Human Touch Remain?  

Technology and AI are becoming part of almost every aspect of modern life—even massage therapy, a service once thought impossible to replace.

Today, robotic massage systems are already being used in Germany, offering adjustable pressure, speed, and heat. We are not here to decide which is better, because technology will continue to evolve.

At the same time, we believe traditional Thai massage is an art worth preserving.

The warmth of human touch, the ability to feel muscle tension, adjust pressure, and respond to each guest’s needs are qualities that machines cannot yet fully replace. Beyond technique, there is also care, attention, and genuine human connection.

We invite everyone to experience authentic Thai massage from skilled therapists, offered with attentive service and at a fair price.

Because true relaxation does not always come from the most advanced technology—it can come from skilled hands and genuine care.

Neck and Shoulder Tension: Your Body’s Way of Asking for a Break

Many people don’t realize how much stress they carry in their neck and shoulders. Long hours at a desk, looking down at a phone, driving, or daily stress can cause muscles to become tight and uncomfortable.

A professional massage helps relax tense muscles, improve circulation, and reduce stiffness, allowing your body to move more comfortably. Taking care of muscle tension early can also help prevent it from becoming long-term discomfort.

Sometimes, the best way to feel better isn’t to work harder—it’s simply to give your body the care and relaxation it deserves.

We wash every guest’s feet before treatment—not because you’re having a foot massage, but to ensure hygiene, comfort, and the best massage experience from the very beginning.

At Massage@Le, we believe great massage begins with cleanliness and care. Washing each guest’s feet before treatment helps maintain a hygienic environment, enhances comfort, and supports the well-being of both our guests and our therapists.

It’s a small step that reflects our commitment to professional standards and exceptional service.

Great service begins with mutual respect.

At Massage@Le, we believe that an exceptional massage is built on more than just technique—it begins with mutual respect.

Every guest is welcomed with genuine care, professionalism, and attention to their individual needs. At the same time, our therapists are dedicated professionals who deserve the same kindness, courtesy, and respect they extend to every client.

When guests and therapists treat one another with respect, trust grows naturally. It creates a calm, comfortable atmosphere where every massage can be tailored with care, allowing guests to truly relax and enjoy the experience.
At Massage@Le, we believe exceptional service is created when respect is shared by everyone. And nothing reflects that better than the words of our guests.

Easy Ways to Visit massage@Le (Tha Tian)
Finding the perfect spot to relax in Bangkok's historical heart is easy! We welcome you to massage@Le (Tha Tian). 

We are nestled in the narrow alley shared with the charming Sala Arun Hotel. You can easily find the alley entrance by looking for the famous Nusara restaurant.

Getting to us is a breeze, connecting you to other major sights with ease:
 🚝MRT Subway: Just a short, pleasant walk from MRT Sanam Chai Station, Exit 1 or 2 (about 600 meters, or 7 minutes).

 ⛴️Chao Phraya Express Boat: We are incredibly close to Tha Tian Pier (about 200 meters, or 3 minutes), where you can catch the fast Orange Flag Express Boat.🔶

 🔷🛥️Blue Flag Tourist Boat: For a leisurely trip to sights like Wat Arun, Tha Maharaj, Tha Phra Athit, ICONSIAM, or Sathorn, use the Tourist Blue Flag Boat at Rajinee Pier (about 900 meters, or a 10-minute walk).

 🚖🚙Electric MuvMi Tuk-Tuk: Explore nearby historic areas like Song Wat Road, Yaowarat (Chinatown), or Khaosan Road. Download the MuvMi app and call an affordable electric tuk-tuk. The closest convenient booking and pickup point near our shop is at the bus stop 🚏at Wat Pho.
After your relaxing massage, you are perfectly situated to explore the cultural wonders of Old Bangkok.

🤰 Pregnancy Massage

Discover the Golden Facial at Loft Thai Spa, one of our best-selling and award-winning facial treatments in Bangkok.

Formulated with 24K gold, this luxurious facial helps hydrate the skin, restore radiance, smooth the appearance of fine lines, and leave the complexion visibly brighter and refreshed.

Advance booking is recommended.

Discover the Thai Combination Massage, a unique signature technique available exclusively at Loft Thai Spa Bangkok.

Blending traditional Thai pressure, assisted stretching, deep muscle work, and relaxing flowing movements, this treatment is designed to release tension, improve flexibility, and restore balance throughout the body.

Experience Thai massage differently, only at Loft Thai Spa.

Relieve the tension of modern working life with our Office Syndrome Therapy, one of the best-selling treatments at Loft Thai Spa.

Our therapists receive advanced specialist training in targeted techniques designed to release deep tension in the neck, shoulders, back, arms, and other areas affected by long hours at a desk.

More than a massage, it is a personalized therapeutic experience created to help you move, work, and feel better.

Book your Office Syndrome Therapy at Loft Thai Spa in Bangkok.

At Loft Thai Spa, every treatment is built on more than a simple protocol. It reflects genuine expertise, continuous training, and a deep passion for the art of traditional Thai massage.

Our team works closely with Nuad Thai School, our professional massage academy in Bangkok. Through this collaboration, our therapists receive regular training, evaluations, and ongoing support to maintain service standards comparable to leading international spas and luxury hotels.

Nuad Thai School does not only train our own teams. The academy also supports spas, hotels, wellness centres, and entrepreneurs in more than 50 countries, helping them develop treatment protocols, train therapists, structure operations, and improve the overall guest experience.

This international expertise allows Loft Thai Spa to deliver an authentic, consistent, and highly professional wellness experience, with treatments adapted to the individual needs of every guest.

From traditional Thai massage and aromatherapy to deep tissue massage, head spa, facials, and signature rituals, every detail is carefully designed and delivered with precision.

Loft Thai Spa’s professional massage academy, Nuad Thai School, now offers 24 online video courses for beginners, intermediate learners, professional therapists, and travellers looking for an authentic Thai wellness discovery experience.

Learn from Bangkok’s experienced therapists, wherever you are and at your own pace.

From beginner workshops to advanced certified programs, Nuad Thai School offers more than 30 certified training courses for anyone who wants to learn authentic techniques, improve their skills, or prepare to open their own spa.

Our programs cover body treatments, facial treatments, pregnancy massage, office syndrome therapy, cupping therapy, Thai Warrior Massage, lymphatic drainage, and many other specialized techniques.

This is also one of the reasons why Loft Thai Spa can provide such a wide variety of treatments at a consistently high professional level. updatesFromCustomers.text:
Unexpected 2nd visit to Prestige after the 1st massage experience with Therapist Barry. For this time, I just walked in and they arranged Therapist Arthit for my 2 hours session.

Despite Therapist Arthit has only 1 year & 4 months field experiences, his skills are truly remarkable. During the warm up session, my body feels nothing yet and I requested him to put on more strength, honestly speaking I don't regret at all. He uses elbow, arm and palm very much throughout the session, and I had many deep breaths when he pushed the points. It's not like I'm having pain, but when he massaged my calf and thighs, I felt my muscles and nerves move around each time he pressed on the right point. The sores are ultimate - to me "mai ched mai sabai", being able to feel the sores during the massage means that your masseurs are performing well and focusing on your right needs.

Again, to the people who wish to visit Prestige and appoint Therapist Arthit, be sure your pain endurance are high. Tell him nicely on the spot if the pain/sores are unbearable, and he accepts your feedback willingly. Please tip him generously for his strength and great efforts.

updatesFromCustomers.text:
กลับมาใช้บริการที่ Ukiyo Massage and Spa เป็นครั้งที่ 2 แล้วและยังประทับใจเหมือนเดิม สิ่งที่ชอบที่สุดคือ "ฝีมือการนวดของพี่จิต" น้ำหนักมือกำลังพอดี นวดได้ตรงจุด จังหวะไล่นิ้วสัมผัสเทพมากคลายความตึงของกล้ามเนื้อดีมาก โดยเฉพาะช่วงบ่าและหลัง รู้สึกผ่อนคลายตั้งแต่ระหว่างนวดจนหลังนวดเสร็จ เป็นการนวดที่มีน้ำหนักพอดีเลย ไม่เบาและไม่แรงจนเกินไป อีกเรื่องที่ประทับใจมากคือ บริการจากคุณผู้จัดการต้อนรับตั้งแต่ก้าวเข้าร้านพร้อมเสิร์ฟรอยยิ้มและ Welcome Drink ซึ่งจำเบอร์ จำหน้าและเรียกชื่อของลูกค้าได้แม้รับบริการเพียง 2 ครั้ง ทำให้รู้สึกเหมือนเป็นลูกค้าประจำที่ได้รับการดูแลอย่างใส่ใจ มีการแนะนำโปรโมชั่นและแพ็กเกจที่คุ้มค่าโดยไม่รู้สึกกดดันเลย อีกทั้งยังสามารถเลือกเบลนด์กลิ่นอโรมาสำหรับการนวดได้เอง วันนี้เลือก กลิ่นกาแฟ หอมละมุน ผ่อนคลายมาก ☕😊
บรรยากาศร้านสะอาด สงบ ตกแต่งสวย กลิ่นอโรมาหอมกำลังดี หลังนวดยังมีชาร้อนและข้าวเหนียวมะม่วงเสิร์ฟ เป็นรายละเอียดเล็ก ๆ ที่ทำให้รู้สึกประทับใจและผ่อนคลายตั้งแต่เข้าร้านจนกลับบ้าน โปรโมชั่นก็คุ้มค่ามาก!!! รอบนี้นวดรวมเกือบ 3 ชั่วโมง จ่ายเพียงแบงก์เทา 2 ใบ ถือว่าคุ้มเกินคาด ส่วนตัวติดใจ การนวดเทียนอุ่น (Ukiyo Candle Massage) มาก เพราะกลิ่นหอมติดผิวแบบอ่อน ๆ ไม่ฉุนจนเกินไป ให้ความรู้สึกผ่อนคลายต่อเนื่องแม้กลับถึงบ้านแล้ว

ใครกำลังมองหาร้านนวดที่ ฝีมือดี บริการอบอุ่น ใส่ใจในรายละเอียด และราคาเข้าถึงได้ แนะนำ Ukiyo Massage and Spa เลยค่ะ แล้วจะเข้าใจว่าทำไมถึงกลับมาซ้ำ 😊🙏

ownerUpdates.text: We’re incredibly proud to share that Chandee Head Spa & Massage has been ranked the

Bangkok has no shortage of massage shops. Every street corner, every mall basement, every hotel lobby. After a while, they blur together.
So when guests from five different countries, who have never met, describe a place as "the most relaxing two hours of my life," it's worth asking what's actually different.
The honest answer: it's not one thing. It's the 17-step Vietnamese head spa ritual. The scalp work that reaches the nervous system directly. The warm water that signals the body it's safe to let go. The starlit ceiling above every bed. The full-body massage and facial in the same visit.
None of it is accidental. All of it is for one outcome: the deepest rest available in Bangkok.
Open daily until 11PM. Silom and Sukhumvit 39.

Bangkok's heat, hard water, and relentless pace do something specific to hair and scalp health. Most people don't connect the dots until they notice more coming out in the shower than usual.
The culprits are real: chlorinated tap water, UV intensity 40% stronger than northern Europe, humidity that traps product buildup, and chronic stress that affects the hair growth cycle directly.
Bangkok expats and long-term visitors are among the guests who find the head spa most transformative. Not because it's a treatment for hair loss, but because regular scalp work improves circulation, removes buildup, and gives the scalp what the city keeps stripping away.
Two locations. Silom and Sukhumvit 39. Open until 11PM.

Something happens when guests lie back under the starlit ceiling, the wind chimes start, and the warm water begins.
They reach for their phones. Not to scroll. To film.
A 1.3 million view TikTok. A 130k-like save from one of Bangkok's most followed travel creators. Guests from a dozen countries, writing the same words without knowing each other: "the ceiling," "I actually fell asleep," "I came back the next day."
We haven't chased this. It happens because the experience is genuinely different from anything else in Bangkok.
500+ five-star reviews. Two locations. Open until 11PM.

Most men who book a head spa for the first time say the same thing afterward.
"Why did I wait so long?"
The reality is nothing like the reputation. No styling. No salon atmosphere. What actually happens is closer to the deepest sleep your nervous system has had in months, delivered through warm water, a starlit ceiling, and hands that know exactly where you've been storing tension.
A significant share of our guests are men. Business travelers. Tourists who found us on TikTok. Couples where the man was initially dragged along and then booked a second session the next day.
Open until 11PM. Silom and Sukhumvit 39. The first time is the hardest part.

Most people don't expect to fall asleep. They arrive tense, lie back, and somewhere around the third step of the ritual, the warm water starts and something in the nervous system just lets go.There's actual science behind this. Warm water sounds trigger a measurable drop in heart rate, comparable to mindfulness meditation. The starlit ceiling above each bed signals the visual cortex to rest. The scalp work activates the vagus nerve directly.We didn't set out to build an ASMR experience. We set out to build the deepest relaxation in Bangkok. It turned out those two things were the same. Open daily 10AM to 11PM. Silom and Sukhumvit 39.

Chandee's Kid Spa gives young travellers their own moment to slow down. From a playful foot massage to the Bubbly Head Spa Adventure , a real head spa ritual, sized for little ones sessions run 60 or 90 minutes.

Most people have heard both terms but aren’t sure which one their skin actually needs. Here’s the quick breakdown:
🌿 **PROBIOTICS** — Calm inflammation and restore balance after disruption from over-cleansing or harsh products. Best for reactive or post-treatment skin. Found in fermented ingredients and bacterial lysates in serums and moisturizers.
🌾 **PREBIOTICS** — Nourish your skin’s existing microbiome so beneficial bacteria can thrive and protect naturally. Best for daily maintenance and long-term microbiome support for all skin types. Found in inulin, beta-glucan, and oat-derived ingredients.

When Robots Begin to Give Massages, Where Does the Value of the Human Touch Remain?  

Technology and AI are becoming part of almost every aspect of modern life—even massage therapy, a service once thought impossible to replace.

Today, robotic massage systems are already being used in Germany, offering adjustable pressure, speed, and heat. We are not here to decide which is better, because technology will continue to evolve.

At the same time, we believe traditional Thai massage is an art worth preserving.

The warmth of human touch, the ability to feel muscle tension, adjust pressure, and respond to each guest’s needs are qualities that machines cannot yet fully replace. Beyond technique, there is also care, attention, and genuine human connection.

We invite everyone to experience authentic Thai massage from skilled therapists, offered with attentive service and at a fair price.

Because true relaxation does not always come from the most advanced technology—it can come from skilled hands and genuine care.

Neck and Shoulder Tension: Your Body’s Way of Asking for a Break

Many people don’t realize how much stress they carry in their neck and shoulders. Long hours at a desk, looking down at a phone, driving, or daily stress can cause muscles to become tight and uncomfortable.

A professional massage helps relax tense muscles, improve circulation, and reduce stiffness, allowing your body to move more comfortably. Taking care of muscle tension early can also help prevent it from becoming long-term discomfort.

Sometimes, the best way to feel better isn’t to work harder—it’s simply to give your body the care and relaxation it deserves.

We wash every guest’s feet before treatment—not because you’re having a foot massage, but to ensure hygiene, comfort, and the best massage experience from the very beginning.

updatesFromCustomers.text:
バンコクトンローで極上の整い😚
日本人オーナーがやっているサウナです。
高温、瞑想、ハーブの3つのサウナ、水風呂が2つ、整いスペースも外気浴と内気浴があります。
サウナ好きなら分かるこだわりが随所に
散りばめられていて、オーナーのサウナ愛が伝わってきました。
日本では体験できない整いスペースでの飲食も楽しめます。
サウナの後にマッサージを受けましたが技術が高くてびっくり。タイ滞在中マッサージ店をはしごしましたが、圧倒的ベストでした。

他の方のコメントで、価格や衛生面への懸念がありましたが、タイのローカルサウナにもいくつか行った身からすると、
この価格でこれだけの品質を提供しているのはあっぱれだと思います。
また行こうと思います！！

XERF ช่วยยกกระชับใต้ตาและลดริ้วรอยได้อย่างไร?
ทำไมผิวใต้ตาถึงเกิดริ้วรอยและหย่อนคล้อยได้ง่าย? คำตอบคือ ผิวบริเวณใต้ตาบางกว่าผิวส่วนอื่น และร่างกายเราเริ่มสร้างคอลลาเจนน้อยลงตามวัย การทำโปรแกรมยกกระชับ XERF จึงเข้ามาช่วยฟื้นฟูโครงสร้างผิวบริเวณนี้โดยเฉพาะ

XERF ทำงานอย่างไรกับชั้นผิว?
XERF ใช้พลังงานคลื่นความถี่วิทยุปล่อยความร้อนที่เหมาะสมลงลึกถึงชั้นผิวอย่างแม่นยำ ครอบคลุมตั้งแต่ชั้นผิวส่วนบน จนถึงชั้นโครงสร้างพยุงผิว(SMAS)โดยมีกลไกหลัก 3 อย่าง:
* 1. ช่วยให้คอลลาเจนหดตัวและกระชับทันที ความร้อนอุ่นๆ จะเข้าไปทำให้เส้นใยคอลลาเจนเดิมที่หย่อนคล้อยเกิดการตึงกระชับขึ้น ส่งผลให้ผิวใต้ตาดูเรียบตึงขึ้นตั้งแต่หลังทำ
* 2. กระตุ้นการสร้างคอลลาเจนใหม่ พลังงานจะไปส่งสัญญาณกระตุ้นเซลล์ผิว ให้สร้างคอลลาเจนและอิลาสตินชุดใหม่ขึ้นมาแทนที่ ริ้วรอยเล็กๆจึงค่อยๆ ตื้นขึ้นอย่างเป็นธรรมชาติ
* 3. ช่วยกระตุ้นการไหลเวียนเลือดใต้ตา เมื่อการไหลเวียนของเลือดและน้ำเหลืองรอบดวงตาดีขึ้น จะช่วยลดการสะสมของเม็ดสี ของเหลว และความเหนื่อยล้า ทำให้ใต้ตาดูสดใส ความคล้ำดูลดลง

ทำไมผลลัพธ์ XERF ถึงอยู่ได้นาน 8–10 เดือน?
หลังทำ XERF ร่างกายจะไม่ได้หยุดทำงานทันที แต่จะ สร้างและจัดเรียงตัวของคอลลาเจนใหม่อย่างต่อเนื่อง ไปเรื่อยๆ โดยจะเห็นผลลัพธ์เต็มที่ในช่วง 1–3 เดือนแรก โครงข่ายคอลลาเจนใหม่ที่แข็งแรงขึ้นช่วยพยุงผิวให้เรียบเนียนและกระชับยาวนานถึง 8–10 เดือน 

💡 สรุปจุดเด่นของ XERF ในเคสนี้
* ลดริ้วรอยเล็กๆบริเวณหน้าผากให้ผิวดูกระชับและเรียบเนียนขึ้น
* กระชับผิวใต้ตา ลดความหย่อนคล้อย
* ช่วยกระตุ้นคอลลาเจนและอิลาสตินให้ผิวใต้ตาหนาขึ้น และคล้ำน้อยลง
* เจ็บน้อย แค่รู้สึกอุ่นๆตอนทำ หลังทำไม่ต้องพักฟื้น หลังทำใช้ชีวิตได้ตามปกติ

LinearZ is the new standard in High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound (HIFU) technology. Developed by the creators of Potenza, this advanced medical device optimizes thermal energy delivery for profound facial contouring and structural skin lifting.
Engineered with precise energy modulation, LinearZ offers multi-site versatility to effectively target the face, abdomen, arms, and thighs. This innovative thermal regulation delivers highly effective tissue coagulation with a drastically reduced pain profile, rendering the use of topical anesthetics (numbing cream) entirely obsolete for this fast, non-invasive treatment.

Keratin vs Olaplex vs Treatment ต่างกันยังไง? เลือกบำรุงผมแบบไหนให้ตรงจุด
หลายคนคงเคยสงสัยว่า Keratin, Olaplex และ Hair Treatment บำรุงผมแตกต่างกันอย่างไร? ทำไมช่างผมถึงแนะนำไม่เหมือนกัน

วันนี้ The Queen Salon & Spa Thonglor ร้านทำผมพรีเมียมย่านทองหล่อ จะพามาเจาะลึกการฟื้นฟูเส้นผมแต่ละประเภท เพื่อให้คุณเลือกโปรแกรมบำรุงผมที่เหมาะกับสภาพผมมากที่สุดค่ะ

1. Olaplex (ซ่อมแซมแกนผมจากภายใน)
•	ฟื้นฟูโครงสร้างพันธะผม (Hair Bonds) ที่โดนทำลาย
•	เหมาะกับคนที่ผมเสียจากการทำสี ฟอกสีผม กัดผม หรือผ่านความร้อนสูง
•	ผลลัพธ์ แกนผมแข็งแรงขึ้น ยืดหยุ่น ไม่ขาดหักง่าย

2. Keratin / เคราติน (ปิดเกล็ดผม ลดผมชี้ฟู)
•	เติมเต็มโปรตีนและเรียงตัวเกล็ดผมให้เรียบเนียน
•	เหมาะกับคนที่ผมชี้ฟู ผมแห้งกร้าน ไร้น้ำหนัก จัดทรงยาก
•	ผลลัพธ์ ผมเรียบลื่น เงางาม ตรงสวย และลดเวลาการเซ็ตผม

3. Hair Treatment / ทรีตเมนต์ (บำรุงผิวผมด้านนอก)
•	เติมความชุ่มชื้นและความเงางามให้ชั้นนอกของเส้นผม
•	เหมาะกับคนที่ผมแห้งเล็กน้อย ต้องการความนุ่มสลวยด่วน
•	ผลลัพธ์ ผมนุ่มลื่น สัมผัสได้ทันทีตั้งแต่ครั้งแรกที่ทำ

สูตรฟื้นฟูผมสวยแบบครบวงจร (Combined Hair Care)
•	Olaplex = แข็งแรงจากแกนใน
•	Keratin = เรียบลื่น ลดชี้ฟู
•	Treatment = นุ่มสลวย เติมความชุ่มชื้น
